name: @tpmjs/tools-discord-chat
description: Read and post in Discord the way a person does: channels by name, catch up on what happened since a time, post or reply, react — bot token or plain webhook

env.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Discord bot token (required for reading; posting can fall back to DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL)

env.name: DISCORD_GUILD_ID
env.description: Default server (guild) id used to resolve channel names

env.name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
env.description: Webhook URL used by discordPost when no bot token / channel is given

tools.name: discordChannels
tools.description: List the text channels the bot can see (id, name, topic, server), optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: discordRead
tools.description: Read recent messages from a channel by name or id, newest last, with authors, attachments and reply links.

tools.name: discordCatchUp
tools.description: Catch up on everything posted since a point in time (e.g. "24h") across one, several or all text channels.

tools.name: discordPost
tools.description: Post a message to a channel by name or id (optionally as a reply), or to DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL when no channel is given.

tools.name: discordReact
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message in a channel.
